note: Both sets cover the same seven claims with accurate quotes and values, so the difference is small. Set B adds the condition "Region 3" to the generator rated speed of 1173.7 rpm, but that speed is a generator property; Region 3 is the context of the blade-pitch PI computation, not a condition on the rated speed, so the condition is misbound. Set A states the rated speed without the spurious condition and is otherwise identical, making it marginally better. Both sets omit the conditional statement that torque is computed as in Region 3 whenever the previous blade-pitch-angle command is 1° or greater, and neither records that the saturation is 10% above rated.
remarks: Both extractions miss the conditional logic (previous blade-pitch-angle command ≥ 1° triggers Region-3 torque computation regardless of generator speed) and the fact that the 47,402.91 N•m limit equals 10% above rated torque — arguably the most distinctive engineering content of the page. The two sets are otherwise near-duplicates, suggesting the same extractor with a minor condition-attribution difference.
